name: Cilo Cybin Holdings Limited
source: Cilo Cybin Holdings Limited audited annual consolidated financial statements for the financial year ended 31 March 2026, results announcement released on SENS 7 September 2026 (https://sharedata.co.za/v2/scripts/SENS.aspx?id=559504), key financial highlights, printed in Rand. Group total revenue R28,814,412 (2025: R35,420,493); group profit for the year a loss of R239,732,145 (2025: profit of R20,052,871); loss per share 95.90 cents (2025: earnings of 9.49 cents). The 2025 comparatives are restated under reverse acquisition accounting following the September 2025 acquisition of Cilo Cybin Pharmaceutical, so they differ from the company level figures previously reported; the 2026 loss includes a one off IFRS 2 share based payment and listing expense of R217,480,665. Cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, finance costs and taxation are not printed in this announcement, so those rows are left empty rather than carried from an unreconciled feed.

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROE (%) = Net Profit / Total Equity x 100

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROA (%) = Net Profit / Total Assets x 100

rows.label: Net Margin (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: Net Margin (%) = Net Profit / Revenue x 100
